@rosemcgowan I am a #MeToo movement, but for me it's about incest, other sexual abuse, brainwashing and torture. We all come to terms with pieces and different angles on the abuse and its effects. Please know I am sending you positive energy, love, justice and peace.
#RoseArmy

@briantylercohen This is so reprehensible that I don't even have a good descriptive term. Amoral? Without human emotions? 

I know! Acting like a friggin asshole-in-chief who has NO line he won't cross.

Well, it's more than a term, but sometimes more words are necessary.

#MeToo
#IBelieveWomen

THREAD

I experienced incest by my father from at least the age of 2 to age 10.

I was molested by a priest in my own home when I was 13.

I was date raped at gunpoint when I was 21.

Every relationship I was in until I was 32 was sexually abusive.

#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors

I do know, however, that each and every man in America owes at least one woman a debt, for having birthed them.

I also know that it's rare for any man to have *only* that female in their lives. Men are fathers and brothers and uncles and grandpas. 

#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors

I don't expect anyone to feel sorry for me. I'm a fighter, apparently from early on. 

I don't expect understanding from those who haven't been sexually assaulted. They can know the details and feel compassion.

But I want or need no pity.

#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors

In fact, I'll bet every man reading this post can name half a dozen women who are or have been important in their lives.

Think about those women. Really think about how much you care.

Now, which of those six women has been sexually assaulted?

#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors

If you have been sexually assaulted, you can contact @RAINN here on Twitter or call them at 1-800-656-4673. They are available 24 hours everyday.

#MeToo
#BelieveSurvivors

This isn't a party position. It's a nonpartisan issue.

Women should not be forced to have sexual contact they don't want.

Period.

#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors
